description: This PHP source file defines the StreamHandler class within the GuzzleHttp library. The class manages HTTP requests using PHP's stream wrappers, including creating streams, handling headers, decoding content, managing timeouts, and supporting proxy and SSL configurations. It facilitates asynchronous sending of HTTP requests and processes responses accordingly.

classes.name: StreamHandler
classes.description: Handles HTTP requests using PHP's stream wrapper, managing request sending, response creation, and decoding contents.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request, optionally delaying, removing 'Expect' header, setting 'Content-Length' for zero-length bodies, and handling exceptions, including network errors.

methods.name: invokeStats
methods.description: Invokes the 'on_stats' callback with transfer statistics if provided in options.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates a PSR-7 Response object from headers and stream, handling errors during header parsing and response creation, and calling 'on_headers' callback if provided.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Creates a sink stream based on options, either returning the stream directly or creating a new stream for writing.

methods.name: checkDecode
methods.description: Decodes content-encoded responses (gzip or deflate) if 'decode_content' option is enabled, and adjusts headers accordingly.

methods.name: drain
methods.description: Drains data from source stream into sink stream, respecting the content length header, then closes the source.

methods.name: createResource
methods.description: Creates and verifies a stream resource, handling errors and restoring error handlers.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a stream resource for the HTTP request, handling schemes, SSL, timeouts, and proxy configurations.

methods.name: resolveHost
methods.description: Resolves the hostname to an IP if 'force_ip_resolve' option is set, supporting IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: getDefaultContext
methods.description: Builds the default stream context for the HTTP request, including headers, method, SSL options, and request body.

methods.name: add_proxy
methods.description: Adds proxy configuration to request options based on provided proxy URL and proxy no-list.

methods.name: parse_proxy
methods.description: Parses a proxy URL into PHP stream context options with 'proxy' and 'auth'.

methods.name: add_timeout
methods.description: Adds timeout setting to request options.

methods.name: add_crypto_method
methods.description: Adds SSL crypto method options to request options, validating the input.

methods.name: add_verify
methods.description: Configures SSL verification options, including CA bundle path or disabling verification.

methods.name: add_cert
methods.description: Adds client SSL certificate and passphrase options.

methods.name: add_progress
methods.description: Registers a progress callback for stream transfer notification.

methods.name: add_debug
methods.description: Enables debug notification callbacks for stream events, writing debug info to provided resource.

methods.name: addNotification
methods.description: Helper to add or wrap stream notification callbacks.

methods.name: callArray
methods.description: Helper to combine multiple callback functions into one.
